profile.headline: Software Engineer whose main motivation is to help people

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
Establishing Fullstack's first entry into teaching Software Engineering in California.  My responsibilities include:

– Mentoring students by providing daily debugging assistance and weekly technical office hours.
– Administering technical interviews for prospective students 2 times weekly.
– Managing student projects from ideation to deployment as team manager, technical mentor and code reviewer.
– Lecturing on algorithms and optimization

positions.title: Store Operations Lead
positions.description:
Store Leads are tasked with organizing the day to day operations to maximize the orders successfully processed and ensuring standard operating procedures are followed.

Main responsibilities include:

–Effectively communicating with teams ranging from 10-14 individuals to meet multiple deadlines throughout the work day.
–Developing team member’s speed and efficiency in standard operating procedures.
–Organizing the team of store operators to process over 1,000 items daily.
–Ensuring optimal work flow is achieved to maximize the amount of orders received throughout the day.
–Coordinating a timely retrieval of parcels by the transportation team.
–Enforcing new SOPs and roll outs of company initiatives.
–Reporting to management on a weekly basis.
